Free diagnostic · about 10 minutes

How ready are you for Saudi Arabia?

Most businesses find out what they missed after they have started. This scorecard helps you find out before. Twenty-four honest questions, a score you can trust, and a report written for your situation.

Start the scorecardPick up where you left off

What you get

A report you can actually use on Monday morning

  • A clear score

    An overall readiness score and a score for each of six areas, so you can see at a glance where you are strong and where you are exposed.

  • A report written for you

    Not a generic PDF. What you read depends on your sector, your stage and the way you answered, including the questions you flagged as not sure.

  • What to do first

    Your three biggest gaps, a short list of actions for each, and a simple 30-day plan, so the result turns into movement.

How it works

Three steps, no sign-up

  1. 1

    Tell us a little about you

    Your sector, your stage and the size of your business. Nothing else, and none of it is required.

  2. 2

    Answer 24 short statements

    Six areas, four statements each. Say how true each one is for you today. “Not sure” is a perfectly good answer.

  3. 3

    Read your report

    See it on screen straight away, print it or save it as a PDF. If you want it emailed to you, we will ask, and only then.

The six areas we look at

  • Strategy & ambitionWhy Saudi Arabia, why now, and what you are really signing up for.
  • Customers & demandWho will buy, why they will choose you, and how you will reach them.
  • Setup & complianceThe legal entity, the licences and the practical business of opening your doors.
  • People & leadershipWho runs it, who joins them, and how Saudisation fits in.
  • Partners & ecosystemWho can open doors, who you can rely on, and who you should be careful with.
  • Finance & governanceMoney, tax, decision-making and what happens when things do not go to plan.

Your answers stay with you

The scorecard runs in your browser. Your answers are saved on your own device so you can pause and come back, and they are not sent to us unless you choose to receive your report by email or ask us to get in touch. If you do, we use your details only for that, as explained in our Privacy Notice.
